summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and corporate developments impacting the retail sector, particularly focusing on bail orders and major investments.

bullets.text: Kerala High Court grants bail to a Sri Lankan approver in the LTTE case, ensuring witness protection.
CJI Surya Kant requests a fact-finding report on complaints against a Jharkhand High Court judge.
Goldman Sachs and SocGen invest ₹920 crore for a 1% stake in Lenskart Solutions, acquiring shares at ₹725 each.
PepsiCo invests over ₹800 crore to establish a new manufacturing plant in Tamil Nadu, creating jobs for women.
Foxconn faces an insolvency lawsuit in India over unpaid vendor dues, complicating its growth plans.
